body:
I started seeing immediate [segfaults in MacOS on Travis](https://travis-ci.org/jeroen/curl/jobs/542985886) for the R bindings with homebrew libcurl 7.65.1, but only for the [curl-openssl](https://github.com/homebrew/homebrew-core/blob/master/Formula/curl-openssl.rb) flavor (which uses nghttp2 and c-ares). The crashes do not appear with the regular [curl (darwinssl)](https://github.com/homebrew/homebrew-core/blob/master/Formula/curl.rb) flavor.

Interestingly I cannot reproduce this locally on my mac with same `curl-openssl`. So it must be a side effect of the Travis environment, which could be related to DNS.
It's more likely to happen with c-ares (or HTTP/2 multiplexing) and it's timing sensitive. #3997 is my initial take at a fix.
Yes, this seems to fix the problem for me. 1000 calls of the command line in my initial report without a single segfault. Yay! :smiley:
Once this is merged in master I can easily check if this also resolves my travis problem.

issue.title: app-tap/http_client.test.lua flaky fails on Mac OS

labels.name: qa
labels.description: Issues related to tests or testing subsystem

repository.name: tarantool
repository.description: Get your data in RAM. Get compute close to data. Enjoy the performance.

issue.body:
Tarantool version: 2.2.0-418-gf824d0927 Darwin-x86_64-Debug.
OS version: Mac OS X Sierra 10.12.6 16G29 (tt-mac).

brew now contains curl-7.65.1 which affected by https://github.com/curl/curl/issues/3995 (this problem leads to segfaults). The next version is not released yet. Linux distros are not affected AFAIK, because don't update curl so fast (at least Gentoo).

The issue hits us in [Travis-CI][1]. It can be reproduced w/o test-run in the following way:

```sh
$ ./src/tarantool -e "for i = 1, 100 do print(require('json').encode(require('http.client').get('http://localhost:1').status)) end os.exit()"
```

I made the following steps on tt-mac:

* brew edit curl; reverted https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-core/pull/40717/files
* brew reinstall curl

After that segfaults are gone.

We possibly should find a way to do so in CI (non-iteractively, it seems we can patch /usr/local/Homebrew/Library/Taps/homebrew/homebrew-core/Formula/curl.rb and run `brew reinstall curl`) or just ignore and wait for the next curl release.

[1]: https://travis-ci.org/tarantool/tarantool/jobs/545711320#L4723
